name: Deeproot Tree
description: Ancient mangrove temple complex and the closest thing the River Heralds have to a capital; ravaged in the invasion.

description_citations.text: "River Heralds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Otepec and Atzocan fall and the Deeproot Tree withers.
timeline.quote: Cities like Otepec and Atzocan fell

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tishana resolves to settle the River Heralds permanently and rename the city the City of Golden Water.
timeline.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

citation.work: Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings
authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story Alternate Endings" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: The death of the Deeproot Tree shifts balances of power, drawing merfolk, mythweavers and adventurers into the caverns.
timeline.quote: The death of the Deeproot Tree further shifted balances of power

citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Heralds defend the Deeproot Tree through a terrible siege; Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa and Vuhana are killed.
timeline.quote: Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa , and Vuhana were killed in the Invasion.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians are driven from the Deeproot Tree, leaving a polluted grave of a swamp.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians would eventually be driven from the sacred site

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
